_about: PROTOTYPE (overnight run). Monolith Survival's Sheet variants; see .scratch/v1-launch/overnight/TOOLS.md. Ids MA–MC (not A–C: those are shared bodies, TOOLS.md §1).

MA.name: White-out: film between two stills on a white band, eight opening slices, world grid, stomp clip beside its prompt

MB.name: Turnaround: film and trailer side by side, pinned flipbook of the eight portraits, timestamped night log, world ticker

MC.name: Product page: film in a main viewer with views and a hang tag, sampled colourway swatches, clips as field tests
